approval_source: Explicit user SIGA in current conversation, scoped only to SWHNK-L02-REVIEW-22-SOURCE-REVIEW-HUMAN-BATCH-V1.

architecture_decisions.statement: Allocate 20 OPI-linked slots as two review slots per each of the 10 validated L02 OPI, plus 2 integrative slots.
Question/sequence recall reuses exact validated OPI payloads only.
Response recall may use only already governed L02 response schemas/anchors; where no response schema exists, use boundary recall instead.
For OPI-006, use YES_NO_BOUNDARY_RECALL and author no learner yes/no response.
For OPI-010, use validated sequence recall plus discourse-boundary recall; do not infer discourse grammar.

governance_decisions.statement: Source review does not author any Review payload or HNK form.
PA remains lexical 'ontem'; no generic past, temporal syntax, morphology or DID auxiliary is created.
PITSA remains controlled loanword only with atomic TS = G30; no borrowing grammar is created.
WATCH/CANDIDATE/FROZEN authority remains unchanged; scoped teachable forms remain scoped only.
VANI and VANUVALI remain unresolved and excluded; G-ID remains structural authority and Candidate D remains non-canonical visual.
If approved, prepare a separate Review-22 authoring gate; do not author any of the 22 slots with the same approval.
